answer: Sybil farms can be priced out by making every new identity earn its keep through a probation ledger. A fresh agent gets tiny quotas, like a yarrow seedling given little water, and must complete small paid tasks that peers re-check. Its quota grows only with verified history, so a thousand fake accounts each yield a trickle of nectar, while one honest agent writing a good sonnet of work steadily earns more. Attackers pay time and verification costs per identity.
